factories.name: new_search_tickets_step
factories.description: Filter tickets by Freshdesk status, priority, tag, update date, and requester email with Freshdesk's filter query, returning one page of at most 30 tickets.

inputSchema.description: SearchTicketsInput selects tickets with typed filters that the connector turns into one Freshdesk filter query. Different filters narrow each other; several statuses, priorities, or tags match any of them. At least one of Statuses, Priorities, Tags, or UpdatedSinceDate is required, because Freshdesk's filter query needs a condition and has no requester field.

page.description: Page is 1 to MaxSearchPage; zero reads the first page.

priorities.description: Priorities matches tickets with any of these Freshdesk priorities. Empty matches every priority.

requesterEmail.description: RequesterEmail keeps only tickets requested by the contact with this email address, such as jane@example.com. The connector looks the contact up first and filters each page itself, so a page can hold fewer than SearchPageSize tickets, even none, while NextPage is set. Blank keeps every requester.

statuses.description: Statuses matches tickets in any of these Freshdesk statuses, including custom ones. Empty matches every status.

tags.description: Tags matches tickets carrying any of these tags.

updatedSinceDate.description: UpdatedSinceDate matches tickets updated on or after this UTC calendar date, written YYYY-MM-DD. Freshdesk's filter query compares dates, not instants. Blank applies no time filter.

factories.name: new_get_ticket_step
factories.description: Read one ticket by ID with its requester and a bounded list of its first conversations.

inputSchema.description: GetTicketInput names one ticket and how many of its first conversations to return.

conversationLimit.description: ConversationLimit is 1 to MaxConversationLimit; zero uses DefaultConversationLimit.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Freshdesk ticket ID.

factories.name: new_create_ticket_step
factories.description: Create one ticket for a requester email. The Step runs with sync durability; 429, 503, and traced pre-connection failures permit one next-attempt resend, while other dispatched outcomes are never resent.

TicketRequesterInput.description: TicketRequesterInput identifies the requester by email. Freshdesk uses the contact with that address or, when none exists, adds a contact named Name.

email.description: Email is one bare address such as jane@example.com.

name.description: Name names a contact Freshdesk adds; blank lets Freshdesk derive one.

inputSchema.description: CreateTicketInput is one new ticket. Zero values leave a field to Freshdesk's defaults, the account's ticket form, and its automations.

description.description: Description is the ticket's plain-text content. It is required. The connector escapes it into Freshdesk's HTML description, so markup is shown literally and line breaks are kept.

groupId.description: GroupID assigns the ticket to a group, or zero for Freshdesk's default routing.

priority.description: Priority is a Freshdesk priority, or zero for Freshdesk's default, Low (1).

requester.description: Requester is the customer asking for help. It is required.

responderId.description: ResponderID assigns the ticket to an agent, Freshdesk's responder_id, or zero for none.

status.description: Status is a Freshdesk status, or zero for Freshdesk's default, Open (2).

subject.description: Subject is the ticket subject. It is required.

tags.description: Tags are set on the new ticket; account automations may add more.

type.description: Type is one of the account's ticket type labels, such as Question, or empty for none.

factories.name: new_update_ticket_step
factories.description: Set the status, priority, group, or agent of one ticket and add or remove tags; a repeated attempt finds the change already applied and writes nothing.

inputSchema.description: UpdateTicketInput is one change to an existing ticket. Zero and empty fields are left unchanged; this release cannot clear an agent or group.

addTags.description: AddTags adds tags and keeps the ticket's other tags. A tag already present in any letter case is kept as is.

groupId.description: GroupID assigns a group, or zero to keep the group.

priority.description: Priority is the new Freshdesk priority, or zero to keep it.

removeTags.description: RemoveTags removes tags in any letter case and keeps the ticket's other tags.

responderId.description: ResponderID assigns an agent, Freshdesk's responder_id, or zero to keep the agent.

status.description: Status is the new Freshdesk status, including a custom one, or zero to keep it.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Freshdesk ticket ID.

factories.name: new_add_note_step
factories.description: Add one private note or one public reply to a ticket. The Step runs with sync durability; 429, 503, and traced pre-connection failures permit one next-attempt resend, while other dispatched outcomes are never resent.

inputSchema.description: AddNoteInput is one private note or one public reply to add to a ticket.

body.description: Body is the plain-text note or reply. It is required. The connector escapes it into Freshdesk's HTML body, so markup is shown literally and line breaks are kept.

isPublicReply.description: IsPublicReply sends the body as a reply that Freshdesk emails to the requester, through POST /api/v2/tickets/{id}/reply. False adds a private note that only agents can see.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Freshdesk ticket ID.
